chapter_note: Clean chapter structure: dialogue frame (¶1) → substrate teaching (¶2-6) → exhortation (¶7) → dialogue frame closure (¶8). The substrate core is a tightly structured cosmological correspondence teaching mapping two daily solar phenomena (sunrise/sunset) onto two terminal cosmic events (First Man's descent into Darkness / Last Statue's final ascent). Both sides of every mapping remain within the cosmic system. The teaching uses the natural solar cycle as a correspondential key to the entire cosmic drama — the 'second time' of mixture is the daylight between two eternal nights. The exhortation in ¶7 is a clear later addition applying the teaching to pastoral urgency. No editorial bridge material detected. The substrate dominates this chapter.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure dialogue frame formula: 'Once again he speaks to his disciples' plus a formulaic attention-calling instruction ('Pay attention, look and understand in the way that I show you'). No substantive cosmological content — the instruction to attend is pedagogical framing, not teaching. High dialogue_frame score (26.32) confirms.

paragraphs.core_text: Two great mysteries are apparent in this shining sun, at its rising and setting. Now, at the moment when it rises and is visible in the universe, all creatures of flesh shall lift up their heads fr[om their sleep] towards the splendour of the sun, and open their doors. While at evening time, when the sun sinks from the universe, all people from every place and even all beasts shall go in to their dark hiding places. The population of the entire universe shuts their doors and dark night overcomes them. They go inside and stay within the dark night in their hiding places.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Establishes the correspondential framework: two solar mysteries (rising/setting) mapped to the behavior of all creatures. Both sides are cosmic-natural — sun's cycle maps to universal creature response. Entirely impersonal, systematic, observational. The teaching structure IS the two-mystery framework that the subsequent paragraphs will develop. No temporal markers pointing outside the system.

paragraphs.core_text: Very great is this mystery revealed by the sun! For when the sun rises and [be]come[s] visible at the beginning of the day all people open their doors, and all of humanity and every creature emerges onto the ear[th] to destroy this Light Cross that is established i[n] silence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Develops the first mystery (sunrise). The natural phenomenon (creatures emerging at dawn) is mapped to a cosmic reality: the destruction of the Light Cross established in silence. Both sides remain within the cosmic system — 'Light Cross' is a cosmic entity (the suffering light bound in matter), not a contemporary institution. The mapping is cosmos→cosmos.

paragraphs.core_text: This pertains to the mystery of the First Man, because when he came out from the grea[t]ness he shone forth over all the children of Darkness. At that mome[nt] all the children of Darkness came forth from their storehouses, its powers and its armies, abandoning their caves and their black abyss. They destroyed the [outer] body of his five sons, who were swathed over hi[s b]o[dy, in t]hat first struggle. ⟨p.165⟩
paragraphs.temporal_note: Maps sunrise-mystery to the primordial cosmic event: First Man's descent and the attack by the children of Darkness. 'This pertains to the mystery of...' is the substrate's own correspondential voice — it connects domain A (solar) to domain B (cosmogonic). Both sides remain cosmic: First Man, five sons, children of Darkness, storehouses, caves, black abyss — all cosmic geography and agents. The five sons and the first struggle are core cosmological architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, when the sun sinks from the universe and sets, and all people go in to their hiding places and houses and conceal themselves; this also pertains to the mystery of the end, as it presages the consummation of the universe. For, when all the light will be purified and redeemed i[n] the universe at the last, the collector of all things, the Last Statue, will gather in and sculpt it/self. It is the last hour of the day, the time when the Last Statue will go up to the aeo[n of] light. The enemy too, death, will go in to bondage; to the prison of the souls of the de[ni]iers and blasphemers who loved the darkness. They will go in with it to bondage and the dark night overcomes th[em]; and thenceforth this name 'light' will not shine upon them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Maps sunset-mystery to the eschatological cosmic event: the Last Statue's ascent and the final imprisonment of Death. Highest substrate score in the chapter (7.09). Both sides remain cosmic: Last Statue, aeon of light, enemy/death, bondage, light/darkness. 'Deniers and blasphemers who loved the darkness' are eschatological soul-categories within the cosmic framework, not identifications of contemporary groups — they describe a cosmic fate, not a social institution. The entire paragraph maps sunset → consummation within the system.

paragraphs.core_text: Behold the two mysteries made visible daily in the sun, which is this splendrous light-giver.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summary closure of the two-mystery teaching. 'Behold' here is demonstrative (pointing to what was just taught) rather than exhortative. Content remains entirely within the cosmic system: two mysteries, the sun, daily visibility. This restates and closes the framework established in ¶2.

Clear exhortation layer. 'I say to you, my brothers and loved ones' is direct community address. 'Take trouble and train yourselves, and preach to the souls' is pastoral mission instruction. 'Seize the moment, while alive, for their repentance' maps the teaching (daylight = time of mixture) into pastoral urgency — one side of the mapping now reaches outside the cosmic system into the audience's present situation. 'Before the door is shut' echoes the sunset teaching but applies it to the community's mission. Institutional vocabulary (4.23) confirms. This is a compiler's devotional application appended to the substrate core.

Formulaic disciple-response closure: 'When his disciples heard this, they were frightened and alarmed and disturbed.' Standard dialogue frame reaction pattern. Heavy lacunae in the remainder. The response formula and desire for salvation ('saved from death... imperishable aeon for ever') are conventional session-ending language.
